name: desktop-sidebar
title: Desktop sidebar
note: Three groups. The account card opens your menu, which holds “Open Concert Crawl”. No User app / Admin toggle in the header.

name: mobile-one-nav
title: Mobile: one nav
note: Four tabs. No slide-out shelf.

name: more
title: More
note: Everything else, grouped like the sidebar.

name: venues-list-status-columns
title: Venues list, status columns
note: The pink dot means the venue has an item in Needs you, so Latest keeps its room. Levitt and Meow Wolf read “Paused: awaiting reply”. Off-season is a snooze on warnings, not a status, so Fiddler’s Green still reads Crawling.

name: pause-crawling
title: Pause crawling
note: One pause, with a reason and a resume rule. Replaces “Pause crawling” vs “Pause venue”.

name: needs-you-desktop
title: Needs you · desktop
note: Fiddler’s Green is open on the right: likely cause, the last 14 runs, last year’s season, and your answers.

name: needs-you-mobile
title: Needs you · mobile
note: The first two answers are buttons; the rest sit under them.

name: a-batch-of-prices
title: A batch of prices
note: While “Approve every price myself” is on in Prices.

name: all-clear
title: All clear
note: The empty state carries the crawl summary, so you don’t need Health to feel done.

name: show-dropped-off-a-calendar
title: Show · dropped off a calendar
note: Ticket link checked for you; the suggested answer is the primary button.

name: show-renamed-moved
title: Show · renamed “MOVED”
note: We look for the same act at the named venue and offer the merge.

name: venue-auto-paused-after-3-failures
title: Venue · auto-paused after 3 failures
note: Every failed run says why. Needs the crawler to record reasons (engineering).

name: venue-blocked-403-429
title: Venue · blocked (403/429)
note: Never retried automatically. Ask the venue pauses with “Waiting on permission”.

name: artist-wrong-artist-report-or-unsure-match
title: Artist · wrong-artist report or unsure match
note: Candidates best first, with where they’re from and how big they are.

name: event-low-confidence
title: Event · low confidence
note: The venue’s own words, and what we would list.

name: price-check
title: Price check
note: Two prices side by side, plus the ticket page.

name: bug-or-error-report
title: Bug or error report
note: One-off reply, Resolve. Ideas go to the weekly Feedback read instead.

name: health-desktop
title: Health · desktop
note: Four headline tiles, then the detail. No “246 flagged” style numbers: counts that need you live only in Needs you.

name: tiles-in-each-state
title: Tiles in each state
note: Blue is in progress, green fine, amber worth a look, red broken. The chip always says the state in words.

name: health-mobile
title: Health · mobile
note: Under More. Same order as desktop; the site checks fold into the Site tile.

name: venues-desktop
title: Venues · desktop
note: Pink dot: something in Needs you. Filters replace the stat cards. robots.txt is a column and a filter.

name: venue-overview
title: Venue · Overview
note: Ball Arena’s Skipped now says why. The suggestion card appears only when we spot a cheaper or sturdier source.

name: venue-runs
title: Venue · Runs
note: Pick any run, including OK and Skipped, to see how far the extraction got and inspect the page. “This is normal” replaces Mark expected.

name: venue-source
title: Venue · Source
note: One choice instead of three overlapping selectors. Pace and schedule are shown as rules, not fields.

name: venues-mobile
title: Venues · mobile
note: No stat cards: the list starts on the first screen. Add is the + button.

name: venue-mobile
title: Venue · mobile
note: Back points back. Tabs scroll sideways; Overview stacks the same cards.

name: the-menu
title: The ⋯ menu
note: Hide and Delete each open a confirm sheet, like Pause crawling in Foundations.

name: add-a-venue-start
title: Add a venue · start
note: Most asked first. Every row gets the same Set it up; a venue whose robots.txt disallows its calendar offers Ask the venue instead.

name: ask-the-venue
title: Ask the venue
note: Drafts a permission note that opens in your own email, saves the venue as a draft paused “waiting on permission”, and brings it back to Needs you after 14 days without a reply.

name: step-2-source
title: Step 2 · Source
note: One column: where its shows are, then the test crawl with what we checked.

name: step-3-icon-optional
title: Step 3 · Icon (optional)
note: Stacked: references, drafts (each at 20/32/48), then the full-size hero. Example glyphs, drawn for this board; the hero is the real renderer from the B+ venue page.

name: step-4-first-timer-guide-optional
title: Step 4 · First-timer guide (optional)
note: The live guide’s fields: Insider tip first (never drafted), Accessibility required, then the chips. Every field is editable here, with the 400-character limit. “Can’t document yet” still works for Accessibility.

name: step-1-basics-mobile
title: Step 1 · Basics · mobile
note: Pre-filled from what we noticed. Capacity is a type plus a number. The main button never clips.

name: step-5-review-mobile
title: Step 5 · Review · mobile
note: What’s done, what waits. Go live publishes the tested shows.

name: all-six-settings
title: All six settings
note: Street, Outdoor and Arena exist today; Theater, Club and Gallery are new. Each shown with a real venue’s glyph.

name: source-test-running
title: Source · test running
note: Each check ticks off as it happens.

name: source-robots-txt-disallows
title: Source · robots.txt disallows
note: The step stops. Ask the venue is the main action.

name: source-no-shows-found
title: Source · no shows found
note: Says what each method found, and offers the usual fix.

name: icon-drafting
title: Icon · drafting
note: Skeleton rows in the stacked layout.

name: icon-drafts-failed-the-style-check
title: Icon · drafts failed the style check
note: Off-grid or filled drafts are hidden, not shown.

name: guide-nothing-to-draft-from
title: Guide · nothing to draft from
note: Starts blank; still editable in the flow.

name: review-not-ready
title: Review · not ready
note: Only Source blocks Go live. Save as draft keeps it.

name: start-nobody-asked-yet
title: Start · nobody asked yet
note: Empty state for the suggestions list.

name: after-ask-the-venue
title: After Ask the venue
note: The draft venue on the Venues list, with the reply buttons.

name: events
title: Events
note: Price column fits wide ranges ($89.50–$1,250). Status uses the fan-facing words; Hidden is separate.

name: event-edit
title: Event edit
note: View on Concert Crawl and on the venue’s site, side by side. Amber lineup token: an unsure artist match. Edit price opens the shared price sheet.

name: artists-to-check
title: Artists · To check
note: Shows in the next 60 days first, matching Needs you. The canonical-name cut (“Beacons & Brews” → Beacons) is called out on the row.

name: prices-missing-a-price
title: Prices · Missing a price
note: Soonest and most Watched first. Add price opens the same sheet fans use.

name: prices-submitted-prices
title: Prices · Submitted prices
note: Who sent it (a handle), what backs it, and where it is. Waiting for you appears only while you approve every price yourself.

name: events-mobile
title: Events · mobile
note: Cards, not a sideways table.

name: prices-mobile
title: Prices · mobile
note: Tabs become a segmented control with counts, so nothing hides.

name: prices-price-checks
title: Prices · Price checks
note: Both prices side by side, with what we checked. Open and Resolved; the same open items also sit in Needs you.

name: event-menu
title: Event ⋯ menu
note: Both “View on” links live here and on the edit page. Merge is for duplicates.

name: prices-row-menu
title: Prices row ⋯ menu
note: Reject unpublishes and tells the fan why.

name: event-edit-mobile
title: Event edit · mobile
note: Same fields, stacked, Save pinned.

name: artists-search-opens-the-side-panel
title: Artists · Search opens the side panel
note: The panel overlays the table, which keeps its full width. Search lists every result, best for Denver first; the row stays highlighted.

name: prices-add-a-price-in-flow
title: Prices · Add a price in flow
note: Ticket page first, then the price. Publish and next opens the next show without one, so the backlog can be worked in one sitting.

name: event-edit-mark-cancelled-desktop
title: Event edit · Mark cancelled (desktop)
note: A centered dialog over the edit page, because it notifies Watchers.

name: artist-search-mobile
title: Artist search · mobile
note: Full screen, because it needs the keyboard and a long scrolling list. The short forms below are sheets.

name: add-a-price-mobile
title: Add a price · mobile
note: Bottom sheet over Missing a price.

name: mark-cancelled-mobile
title: Mark cancelled · mobile
note: Bottom sheet.

name: people
title: People
note: Handle, role, how they joined, last active. No emails and no ids. Filters for Beta, Admin and Test accounts.

name: person
title: Person
note: Stats in the locked words (Watching, Concerts, Submitted prices). Role, the flags they are trying early, the code that brought them in, and what they did lately.

name: make-an-admin-asks-first
title: Make an admin · asks first
note: The only role change that asks. Member and Beta switch in place, with an Undo.

name: people-mobile
title: People · mobile
note: Rows, not a sideways table. People, Codes and Posters are a segmented control.

name: person-mobile
title: Person · mobile
note: The same blocks, stacked.

name: more-mobile
title: More · mobile
note: One nav: the tab bar plus this list. No hamburger shelf repeating the tabs. Open Concert Crawl is here and in the desktop user menu.

name: user-menu-mobile
title: User menu · mobile
note: Tap your avatar at the top of any tab. Same three rows as desktop.

name: invite-codes
title: Invite codes
note: Label under the code, seats as a bar, who made it as a handle. Statuses: Active, Full, Expired, Revoked.

name: new-code-in-flow
title: New code · in flow
note: Side panel over the list. “Make a poster for it next” goes straight to Posters with the code picked.

name: a-code-in-flow
title: A code · in flow
note: Who joined with it, linked to their person page. Copy link, make a poster, add seats, revoke.

name: code-row-menu
title: Code row ⋯ menu
note: For an Active or Full code. Clicking the row itself opens the code panel.

name: code-row-menu-expired-or-revoked
title: Code row ⋯ menu · Expired or Revoked
note: Ended codes stay listed; Reactivate brings one back.

name: revoke-asks-first
title: Revoke · asks first
note: Says what happens to people who joined and to printed posters.

name: invite-codes-mobile
title: Invite codes · mobile
note: Cards; New code on top.

name: new-code-mobile
title: New code · mobile
note: Bottom sheet.

name: posters-mobile
title: Posters · mobile
note: Fixes the broken look picker: Night and Paper stack as two choices. Steps stay in order above the preview; Print stays pinned.

name: staging-admin-feature-flags
title: Staging admin · Feature flags
note: One row per flag: who sees it here, then on the right whether it is verified. Mark verified appears once the flag is on for anyone.

name: mark-verified-asks-first
title: Mark verified · asks first
note: How a flag gets verified: a short check and an optional note, which both admins show.

name: a-flag-in-staging-admin-in-flow
title: A flag in staging admin · in flow
note: Named people on top of a step, the verified note, and history.

name: production-admin-feature-flags
title: Production admin · Feature flags
note: The right column reads staging: verified or not, and its step. Wrong-artist reports stays locked until it is verified.

name: a-flag-in-production-admin-in-flow
title: A flag in production admin · in flow
note: Staging’s answer on top, then production’s own step and named people.

name: everyone-in-production-asks-first
title: Everyone in production · asks first
note: The one step that reaches every fan asks, with the number of people it reaches.

name: production-flags-mobile
title: Production flags · mobile
note: Status sits beside the name; the ladder takes the full width under it.

name: feedback
title: Feedback
note: Kinds as small-caps labels: Bug, Error report (from Sentry, counted by people), Idea, Suggest a venue. To read and Done replace Active, so a resolved item never sits in the active list. Each row says where else it shows.

name: a-feedback-item-in-flow
title: A feedback item · in flow
note: Opens in the side panel over the list, like every other edit. Context is readable: the page by name, the device in words. One set of buttons: Mark done, Reply, GitHub.

name: reply-in-flow
title: Reply · in flow
note: Reply swaps the panel to a short form. One reply, sent as an in-app notice plus an email. If they answer, it arrives as new feedback, so there is still no thread to track.

name: feedback-mobile
title: Feedback · mobile
note: The filters stay as chips with counts.

name: feedback-item-mobile
title: Feedback item · mobile
note: Mark done, Reply and GitHub pinned at the bottom.

name: reply-mobile
title: Reply · mobile
note: Bottom sheet over the item.

name: fan-what-you-missed
title: Fan · What you missed
note: The reply sits with their other notices, labeled From Concert Crawl.

name: fan-the-reply
title: Fan · the reply
note: Signed by the admin who wrote it, with their own note quoted.

name: fan-the-email
title: Fan · the email
note: Same words. Says replies to the email aren’t read, and where to write instead.

name: fan-account-menu-send-feedback
title: Fan account menu · Send feedback
note: One new row in the App group. No floating tab.

name: fan-send-feedback
title: Fan · Send feedback
note: The existing modal with plain kinds, including Suggest a venue. It says where an answer would appear.

name: emails
title: Emails
note: Only emails we still send (the Spotify digest is gone). Preview with a real show, and send yourself a test.

name: activity-log
title: Activity log
note: Every admin change in words, with who and a link. This is where “Show email” is logged.

name: emails-mobile
title: Emails · mobile
note: Preview fits the phone; test send below it.

name: activity-log-mobile
title: Activity log · mobile
note: One line per change, with who, when and where.

name: user-menu-desktop
title: User menu · desktop
note: Replaces the one-way User app/Admin toggle and the Settings theme picker.

name: not-an-admin
title: Not an admin
note: For a sub-admin opening People.

name: loading-any-list-on-mobile
title: Loading · any list on mobile
note: Needs you, Venues, Events, People and the rest share this shape.

name: loading-any-detail-page-on-mobile
title: Loading · any detail page on mobile

name: save-failed
title: Save failed
note: Any control on these pages: it snaps back and says what is really saved.
